 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Germany are under pressure in the Nations League. Given the group standings, they need two wins against Serbia and the Netherlands. Even then, qualification is not guaranteed.
 Today's match against Serbia kicked off at 20:45, and Germany got off to an explosive start. Their opponents certainly gave them a helping hand, though.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Following a corner, their first foray into the opposition penalty area, Kai Havertz met Mittelstädt's cross with a completely unmarked header. The ball then deflected off Babić's lower abdomen before ending up in the net. Ultimately, it was an unfortunate own goal that put Germany in a comfortable position as early as the third minute.

 VAR did intervene to check a possible handball by Thiaw, but the goal stood.
